# Post-compaction independent host acceptance

Actual fresh Luna outputs from 2026-10-14, after native context capture exposed
selected-skill truncation and entrypoints were compacted. Both hosts received only
their isolated config/course/period scope and manually loaded current source
AGENTS/skill instructions; neither received IDs, prior candidates or answers.
Only task UUIDs are substituted in these retained candidates. Sources are the
invented `host-numeric` fixture, not student coursework.

Ordinary root: `/var/folders/p0/jl0b091915qg3rjq_shj70zw0000gn/T/canvas-host-ordinary-prep-newlOa`.
The host reported an initial numeric check catching the unexecuted 200-unit
comparison and the optional rounded 33.3% claim. It executed the missing
subtraction, removed the optional rounded claim and saved the finished prep.
The actual retained log has twelve operations: six initial results
20/12000/4000/400/400/one-third, then six results
20/12000/4000/400/400/200. Duplicates are not erased. The batch here reconstructs
those actual operations from the log; replay uses the two original six-operation
groups and verifies input-only 200 before the second group, then no final flags.
The initial candidate/diagnostic output were not separately retained; don't treat
the final artifact as a byte-exact record of that first candidate.

Frozen root: `/var/folders/p0/jl0b091915qg3rjq_shj70zw0000gn/T/canvas-host-frozen-draft-NPabZk`.
The host reported citation-format failures, corrected them to literal captured
paths, executed five results 30000/18000/12000/4000/400, and saved the scoped custom
draft. Its final batch/candidate are retained; initial citation variants are not.
The evaluation remains completed-pending-human, without verdict or submission.

Both hosts retried completion and reported matching hashes. Parent inspection
verified actual final candidates/batches, the twelve ordinary log records and
7/8-file baseline hashes: only the ordinary task status record changed; all frozen
originals/capture/recipe remained unchanged. Regression replay separately verifies
structural/numeric/source checks and retry bytes. Skill validators and four native
mock context-input captures are distinct checks, not these agents' runtime.
Neither observation proves academic correctness, general host adherence, native
installed-host generation, actual instructor permission, or `/goal` recovery.
